snippet.title: Deck Vs Doom Trailer
snippet.description:
DECK VS DOOM – Official Trailer

Build your deck. Defend the gate. Become unstoppable.

Deck vs Doom is a strategic roguelite where you build a deck of towers, traps, and spells to survive relentless waves of enemies. Draft powerful cards, collect artifacts, and unlock game-breaking synergies on your quest to hold the gate at all costs.

Survive escalating waves of enemies
Craft the perfect deck with clever combos
Stack artifacts to grow absurdly powerful
Replay endlessly with new builds every run

Launching October 31st on Steam
Try the free demo during Steam Next Fest!

👉 Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2811780/Deck_Vs_Doom/

📣 Join the community:
Discord: https://discord.gg/MZdnV42ejh
